plain_english.rule: Simple, plain English only. Every label and sentence must be understood by a ward nurse or a family member reading it cold. No abbreviations, no jargon, no made-up compound labels. A word here is refused unless the user used it first (list it in turn.user_words).

abbreviations.ARPOB: what one bed earns in a day
abbreviations.ROI: what you get back for what you spend

words.interdependency: how teams rely on each other

tones.rule: The colours never change; their shades do. The generator picks the tone from the turn number, in sets of three: turns 1–3 sage, 4–6 mist, 7–9 sage, and so on through `rotation`. Specs and templates store no colour — Claude never sets a tone. A fill-in-the-blank and its answered redraw keep the tone they started in (set canvas.tone on the redraw only for that).

note: scope "all": the pattern may be used by any tab, redrawn in its look by its own generator. scope "<Tab>": that tab only.
